series.label: US CPI (YoY)
series.note: FRED CPIAUCNS (NOT seasonally adjusted) — the basis for BLS's official headline 12-month rate (was CPIAUCSL/SA, which is wrong for YoY)

series.label: US PCE (YoY)
series.note: FRED PCEPI with units=pc1 (FRED's built-in percent-change-from-year-ago) — the units param rides along on the code field, so no manual YoY here (unlike CPI). The Fed's headline inflation gauge.

series.label: Israel CPI (YoY)
series.note: BoI PRI dataflow, CP = CBS Consumer Price Index (general index); YoY computed here. Switched from FRED ISRCPIALLMINMEI, which stopped updating at 2025-03 (OECD MEI foreign-CPI mirror, discontinued).

series.label: US Fed Funds (target range)
series.note: Numeric backbone is the range's upper bound (DFEDTARU); enrich_policy attaches the lower bound (DFEDTARL) and a combined 'lo-hi' string for the displayed range. DFEDTARL/U begin 2008-12 (the range regime) — that is their full available FRED history.
